title: Grusch's 'alternative timeline' view of the technology
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Grusch's 'alternative timeline' view of the technology, about 2023 (interview after the hearing) at Jesse Michels's interview with David Grusch, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Jesse Michels's interview with David Grusch

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls what David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who spoke to Congress in 2023 about UFOs, told him in an interview after that hearing. According to Michels, Grusch said that if he were a betting man, he would guess the technology is not just a step ahead of ours but something like an "alternative timeline" that developed along a different path. If true, it would mean whoever built it is not just more advanced but fundamentally different from us.
